command:
set -euo pipefail; LEADER=$(machinectl show entityos -p Leader --value); ENVF=/var/lib/entityos/voice/browserless_chatgpt_client/chatgpt-client.env; TOKEN=$(sudo -n sed -n 's/^FRANK_VOICE_BROKER_TOKEN=//p' "$ENVF" | head -n1); echo SERVICE=$(sudo -n nsenter --target "$LEADER" --mount --pid --uts --ipc --net -- systemctl is-active frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service); echo JOURNAL; sudo -n nsenter --target "$LEADER" --mount --pid --uts --ipc --net -- journalctl -u frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -n 30 --no-pager | tail -30; sudo -n nsenter --target "$LEADER" --mount --pid --uts --ipc --net -- env TOKEN="$TOKEN" python3 - <<'PY'
import json,os,urllib.request,uuid,time,hashlib
base='http://127.0.0.1:8765'; token=os.environ['TOKEN']
def call(method,path,obj=None,timeout=30):
    data=None if obj is None else json.dumps(obj).encode(); r=urllib.request.Request(base+path,data=data,method=method,headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+token,'Content-Type':'application/json'}); t=time.monotonic();
    with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=timeout) as f: out=json.load(f)
    print('CALL',path,'elapsed_s',round(time.monotonic()-t,3),'ok',out.get('ok')); return out
h=call('GET','/health',timeout=5); print('HEALTH_BIND',h.get('machine_id'),h.get('owner'),h.get('person'),h.get('active_sessions'))
sid='omega-andreas-browserless-smoke2-'+uuid.uuid4().hex[:10]
o=call('POST','/v1/session/open',{'session_id':sid},timeout=10); print('OPEN_STATE',o.get('session',{}).get('identity_state'))
s=call('POST','/v1/session/select',{'session_id':sid,'person':'andreas'},timeout=60); print('SELECT_STATE',s.get('session',{}).get('identity_state'),'epoch',s.get('session',{}).get('runtime_epoch_id'))
t=call('POST','/v1/session/turn-context',{'session_id':sid,'query':'Lokaler Reentry-Selbsttest ohne externe Effekte oder Netzwerkzugriff.','char_budget':1200},timeout=60); meta={'machine_id':t.get('machine_id'),'owner':t.get('owner'),'identity_state':t.get('session',{}).get('identity_state'),'runtime_epoch_id':t.get('session',{}).get('runtime_epoch_id'),'titan_bytes':len(t.get('titan_context') or ''),'emergent_bytes':len(t.get('emergent_context') or ''),'state_keys':sorted((t.get('state') or {}).keys()),'assembly_sha256':hashlib.sha256((t.get('identity_active_assembly') or '').encode()).hexdigest()}; print('REENTRY_META',json.dumps(meta,sort_keys=True)); c=call('POST','/v1/session/close',{'session_id':sid,'reason':'smoke2_complete'},timeout=30); print('CLOSED',c.get('closed'))
PY
PID=$(sudo -n nsenter --target "$LEADER" --mount --pid --uts --ipc --net -- systemctl show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p MainPID --value); echo CLIENT_PID=$PID; sudo -n nsenter --target "$LEADER" --mount --pid --uts --ipc --net -- pstree -ap "$PID" | head -60; if sudo -n nsenter --target "$LEADER" --mount --pid --uts --ipc --net -- pstree -ap "$PID" | grep -Eiq 'chrome|chromium|brave|playwright'; then echo CLIENT_BROWSER_DESCENDANTS=BAD; exit 31; else echo CLIENT_BROWSER_DESCENDANTS=0; fi; echo BROWSERLESS_SMOKE2=PASS
